mintAuthority.summary: USTB has independent native issuance surfaces on Ethereum, Plume, and Solana. On Ethereum and Plume, the issuer controls each token proxy's direct mint path and its ProxyAdmin through the issuer EOA; Plume additionally exposes owner-only mint and bulkMint with no observed timelock. On Solana, the Token-2022 mint has a live issuer mint authority held by a System Program-owned account. These three native controls remain separate from the documented Plume-to-Ethereum issuer-native burn/mint bridge reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: USTB token proxy
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294990, owner() = 0xad309BB6f13074128b4F23EF9EA2fe8552AfCA83 (unchanged from block 25166611). Implementation slot = 0x1f50a1ee0ec8275d0c83b7bb08896b4b47d6e8c4, proxy admin = 0xb9d285dcad879513dc9c1a3b2e0cccb21c3c2146. ProxyAdmin owner() = same issuer EOA.

controls.label: USTB token owner / ProxyAdmin owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294990, eth_getCode returned '0x' (no bytecode), confirming an EOA. This issuer-context EOA is consistent with enterprise MPC/HSM custody and owns both the token and ProxyAdmin paths.

controls.label: USTB Plume token proxy
controls.capDescription: The verified Plume implementation exposes owner-only mint and bulkMint with no protocol cap or timelock evidenced in the native issuance path.
controls.evidence: At Plume block 87678057, USTB proxy 0xe4fa682f94610ccd170680cc3b045d77d9e528a8 returned owner 0xad309BB6f13074128b4F23EF9EA2fe8552AfCA83, implementation 0x2151706cb4763c20381a8860e25a713f6e1e3b93, and proxy-admin 0xa5df717b304a50838c72cd310c8df636b1aecfa3. The verified ABI exposes owner-only mint and bulkMint, and the transaction history records an owner mint at block 85248240 on 2026-08-04.

controls.label: USTB Plume token owner / ProxyAdmin owner
controls.capDescription: The issuer EOA can call the owner-only Plume mint and bulkMint functions; no on-chain cap or delay was evidenced.
controls.evidence: At Plume block 87678057, owner() returned issuer EOA 0xad309BB6f13074128b4F23EF9EA2fe8552AfCA83 and the verified owner-only mint/bulkMint ABI exposed direct native issuance. No timelock or external validator control was evidenced for this EVM native supply path.

controls.label: USTB Solana Token-2022 mint authority
controls.capDescription: The finalized Token-2022 mint read returned live mintAuthority with supply 224,119.498751 USTB; no program or multisig cap was evidenced. The mint-authority account is System Program-owned. Solana freezeAuthority, permanent delegate, and default-frozen controls remain holder-transfer concerns in their owning risk review and are not part of native Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439721950, Token-2022 mint CCz3SGVziFeLYk2xfEstkiqJfYkjaSWb2GCABYsVcjo2 reported mintAuthority EfkJFKtVcpo8sgQGWLoaYcutxNdmqed81wdCcpn7egdz and supply 224,119.498751 USTB. The authority account is System Program-owned, so it is represented as a direct native minter; freezeAuthority and permanent-delegate state are intentionally left outside Mint Authority.

review.evidence: USTB has three independently documented native issuance surfaces. Ethereum is an upgradeable token proxy whose issuer EOA owns both token and ProxyAdmin; Plume is a separately deployed upgradeable token proxy with owner-only mint/bulkMint, ProxyAdmin 0xa5df717b304a50838c72cd310c8df636b1aecfa3, and the same issuer EOA owner at block 87678057; Solana Token-2022 has live mintAuthority EfkJFKtVcpo8sgQGWLoaYcutxNdmqed81wdCcpn7egdz in finalized slot 439721950, with the authority account owned by the System Program. The three-ledger native controls support unbounded, periodic, attestation-only issuance posture. The documented Plume-to-Ethereum burn/mint bridge is separately scored under bridgeRouteRisk and does not replace or reduce these native controls. FreezeAuthority, permanent delegate, and default-frozen state remain outside Mint Authority.
